test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a circle with centre O, PA and PB are the tangents at A and B, respectively, from an external point P. If ∠APB = 24°, then find ∠AOB.
solution:
**Given:**

In a circle with centre O, PA and PB are the tangents at A and B, respectively, from an external point P.

 ∠APB = 24°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e191264ad72f7989aa0aea9cda2840ccb27c14de45d002ed59314611e29cc6ba.png] 

∠AOB = 180° - ∠APB

⇒ 180° - 24° = 156°
